scope: Prospective input-only comparison design on previously unused Instacart train series, followed by frozen-checkpoint error diagnosis only if input and body comparability gates pass

population.eligibility: Unused train series with at least one legal observed context H>=3 and a following train event; eligibility uses seq/count metadata only
population.context_selection: For each eligible series choose the context end with smallest SHA256('instacart_balanced_temporal_v1:context:20260905:{series_index}:{end}')
population.series_selection: Choose up to 65536 eligible series with smallest SHA256('instacart_balanced_temporal_v1:series:20260905:{series_index}'); process selected rows in original series_index order

input_boundary.metadata_first: Lazily filter train and read only physical row identity, native oper_part_no and seq; preserve full-series native sort and global target offsets before exclusions
input_boundary.observed_values_second: Read gap/quantity only for selected observed physical row IDs; never select each chosen target row during the design phase
input_boundary.duplicate_keys: Detect duplicate series/seq metadata keys before value reads; reject ambiguous ordering rather than silently changing the original event order
input_boundary.observed_transform: Original gap Int32 then minimum1 then Float32; quantity Float32; no appended target or padding in features
input_boundary.same_feature: Reuse observed_features: age_distortion J measures RMS difference of normalized actual age vs event-index age; exclude first retained gap from internal ages; preserve all prior feature definitions
input_boundary.unseen_errors: Do not load prediction/residual caches or model checkpoints before both comparison gates pass

matching_design.changed_design_axis: Exact observed history length H replaces the previous two H bins; all other feature, cutpoint and decision definitions remain fixed
matching_design.cells: Exact H x opposite-fold mean_log_quantity terciles x count_change_rms median x log_mean_internal_gap median
matching_design.cutpoints: J q25/q75 and control cuts use all selected eligible input histories in the opposite fold, before target quantity or model outputs are read; unique sorted boundaries, searchsorted side=right
matching_design.weights: Each retained cell gives each arm total mass min(n_low,n_high); row weight equals that mass divided by its arm count

stage_barriers: Save selected metadata and hashes before reading any selected observed quantity/gap values
Save input features, cuts, all candidate assignments, admitted cells and a hashed input_gate marker before admitting any chosen target quantity
If input gate fails, stop without chosen target labels, checkpoint restoration, predictions or errors
If input gate passes, read quantity only for ALL candidate J-extreme target rows; use only body membership <=25 and recheck comparability

Body phase may only keep/drop input-admitted cells; never add targets or cells. Drop cells failing body20/5; recompute overlap weights from body counts. Retention denominator is ALL pool body-valid extreme rows, including originally unsupported cells
Save hashed body_gate and final frozen assignment before restoring checkpoints; if body gate fails, stop without predictions/errors
Only after both gates pass, evaluate the identical retained targets with original and separate-key checkpoints; no post-prediction reselection, reweighting or gate changes

error_diagnostic.bootstrap: Resample series within each fold with fixed cuts/admitted cells/row weights; normalize each pooled arm in each replicate
error_diagnostic.meaning: Same prospective error-association relevance criterion; not a 5% expected improvement or architecture adoption result

single_hypothesis: Does mismatch between event-index age and actual elapsed-age layout correspond to higher body quantity error among histories comparable in observed count level, length, quantity changes and absolute mean gap?
limitations: Series are unused by the previous temporal diagnosis, but both frozen models already trained on them and checkpoints were selected on validation
One context per unused series is a different population from the old target-weighted8192 sample; changes from its4.489% contrast cannot be attributed only to better length balance
Input comparability can change after body filtering, hence a second gate is required before predictions
Association does not identify causal encoder deficiency or establish that relative-time attention will improve fresh training
If either comparability gate fails, close this fixed design without relaxing thresholds or searching alternative features
